purpose: Offline visual and capture review for the first five one-image ecommerce tests. This is an implementation gate, not audience-performance evidence.
reviewRule: Pass image quality only when the product is identifiable, category-relevant, commercially lit, not plain-background-only, and buyer-critical details remain visible. Pass capture only when the raw recording and timeline are valid.

tests.diagnosis: Amber bottle, black dropper, blank label, warm stone/water/leaf setting; product remains the hero.
tests.nextTest: Use the same product-truth check after valid narration is available.

tests.diagnosis: Whole machine, carafe, coffee, cup, and controls are visible in a believable kitchen scene.
tests.nextTest: Verify zoom does not cut the carafe or controls during the narrated proof.

tests.diagnosis: Shoe is shown in use with the side shape, upper, heel, sole edge, and true light color readable.
tests.nextTest: Keep the sole and heel inside the center-safe crop at every keyframe.

tests.diagnosis: Bag silhouette, strap, material, scale, and warm room context are clear without clutter.
tests.nextTest: Add a proof beat for opening or interior only if the real recording makes it visible.

tests.diagnosis: Watch face, hands, case, crown, bracelet, and controlled highlights are clear; the image passed, but Chromium did not finalize raw-demo.webm.
tests.nextTest: Fix or retry capture finalization before narration/rendering; do not use this kit for a video.

aggregateDecision: The one-image category direction is viable for visual testing across the first five. Production videos remain gated by valid raw capture, valid ElevenLabs authentication, non-overlapping narration, and rendered-video QA.
